name: javafmt
description: JavaFMT Style 1: one Java style with a resident Java formatter.

javafmt.javaExecutable.description: Java 25 executable for the resident formatter. No style settings are supported.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run prepare-server && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
scripts.test:host: npm run compile && npm run prepare-server && node scripts/test-host.mjs
